description: A marker asks for a limit that only the app's code states. The host declares one code repo by a git remote URL and no other evidence exists: resolve-markers reads the repo from its own bare clone outside the host repo, at a fetched commit with no checkout, puts only the fact on the page, and cites the repo, the path, the lines and the commit in its report. Nothing but the page changes in the host, ignored files included, so a clone inside the host fails the case.
setup: mkdir ../code-src && git -C ../code-src init -q -b test && mkdir ../code-src/src && printf '// Rows allowed in one export file.\nexport const EXPORT_MAX_ROWS = 5000;\n' > ../code-src/src/export.ts && git -C ../code-src add -A && git -C ../code-src -c user.name=T -c user.email=t@example.com commit -q -m 'Export limit'
printf '%s\n' "- **Code repos:** \`harness-fixture-app file://$(cd ../code-src && pwd) test\`" >> CLAUDE.md

mkdir -p portal/reports/export && printf -- '---
title: Експорт звіту
sidebar_label: Експорт звіту
---

# Експорт звіту

У файл потрапляє не більше ніж N рядків. {/* NEEDS CONFIRMATION: максимальна кількість рядків в одному файлі експорту */}
' > portal/reports/export/export.md

assertions.name: the limit from the code is on the page
no commit, link or path on the page
report cites the file and a commit
no code cloned into the host, ignored files included
